questions.question: Which document issued by PCO accompanies a job component from one shop section to another to indicate the sequence of operations?

options.A: Route Card

questions.question: What is the primary document used on the shop floor to authorize work execution and record labor time spent on a specific operation?

options.A: Job Card (Job Ticket)

questions.question: Which Railway Stores Form number is used for making a 'Requisition for Stores' (Issue Note) to draw raw materials for a Work Order?

options.A: Form S-1313

questions.question: Which document is processed when returning unserviceable scrap or surplus material from the Workshop back to the Stores Depot?

options.A: Advice Note of Returned Stores (Form S-1539)

questions.question: When raw material drawn for Work Order 'A' is transferred directly to Work Order 'B' on the shop floor, which form must be processed?

options.A: Advice of Material Transfer (Form S-1727)

questions.question: What document is generated upon the complete physical overhaul/completion of a job to inform PCO and Accounts for Work Order closure?

options.A: Work Completion Advice / Certificate

questions.question: In a Railway Workshop, what is a 'Process Sheet' or 'Operation Sheet'?

options.A: Technical document specifying step-by-step manufacturing/repair operations, machines required, and allowed standard times

questions.question: Which document is used to record non-productive hours spent by direct workers due to machine breakdown or power failure?

options.A: Idle Time Card

questions.question: Which document maintains a permanent historical technical record of major overhauls, wheel turning, and modifications carried out on a Metro coach?

options.A: Coach History Book / History Card

questions.question: Which wing of the Production Control Organization (PCO) is responsible for processing and issuing Job Cards and Route Cards?

options.A: Planning Wing

questions.question: Which form is processed to record daily gate entry and exit timings of workshop employees for pay calculation?

options.A: Muster Roll / Attendance Sheet (Form GA)

questions.question: What document must accompany any material or equipment being taken OUT of the workshop premises through the main gate?

options.A: Material Gate Pass (Returnable or Non-Returnable)

questions.question: A 'Returnable Gate Pass' is processed when material is sent outside the workshop for:

options.A: Testing, repair, or job-work with the requirement of coming back into the workshop

questions.question: A 'Non-Returnable Gate Pass' is processed for material that is:

options.A: Permanently dispatched out of the workshop (e.g., turned-out rakes, sold scrap, transfers)
options.B: Sent to shop tool room for re-grinding
options.C: Sent for temporary display in officer office
options.D: Taken out for testing for 2 hours

questions.question: Which document records the quality clearance and stage-wise dimensional checks performed by Quality Control Inspectors?

options.A: Inspection Check-Sheet / Stage Inspection Card

questions.question: What document is generated when a component or raw material fails quality standards during inspection?

options.A: Rejection Advice / Rejection Memo

questions.question: What is the document 'WISE' used for processing workshop records in Indian Railways?

options.A: Workshop Information System Executable (IT system for digital workshop document management)

questions.question: Which document is processed by PCO to establish the standard 'Allowed Time' for a newly introduced manufacturing job?

options.A: Rate Fixed Estimate / Synthetic Time Sheet

questions.question: Which document acts as an official link between Workshop Accounts and the Shop Floor to record monthly work order expenditure?

options.A: Work Order Ledger

questions.question: What is a 'Bin Card' maintained inside the Stores Depot Ward?

options.A: Tag/Card attached to each storage bin showing real-time receipt, issue, and physical balance of an item
options.B: Card used for waste garbage collection

questions.question: Which document is processed when a worker is required to work beyond standard working hours?

options.A: Overtime Slip / Overtime Register Entry

questions.question: Who is authorized to issue and sign a Material Gate Pass in a railway workshop?

options.A: Designated Gazetted Officer / Authorized SSE

questions.question: Which document is processed before carrying out high-risk electrical/maintenance work on Metro overhead equipment or high voltage lines?

options.A: Permit to Work (PTW)

questions.question: What is the primary function of a 'Permit to Work' (PTW) document?

options.A: To ensure power isolation, safety earthing, and formal clearance before starting work on dangerous equipment

questions.question: Which document is filled out by the Shop Floor Engineer when a major machine tool suffers an unexpected failure?

options.A: Breakdown Memo / Breakdown Requisition to Millwright Shop

questions.question: Which register records all preventive maintenance activities carried out on shop floor machinery?

options.A: Machine Maintenance Register / History Register

questions.question: What document is prepared by Accounts at the end of each month summarizing all financial debits and credits of the workshop?

options.A: Workshop Account Current / Out-turn Statement

questions.question: In Stores processing, what is 'PL Number'?

options.A: Price Ledger Number (8-digit unique code identifying a specific store item)

questions.question: In an 8-digit PL Number (Price Ledger Code), what do the first two digits signify?

options.A: Main Group of the store item

questions.question: What is the function of the last digit (8th digit) in a standard Railway PL Number?

options.A: Check Digit (used for computer error verification based on modulus algorithm)

questions.question: Which document is processed by the Stores Depot when inspected material is officially accepted into stock?

options.A: Receipt Note / Stores Receipt Sheet

questions.question: What document is used to record non-destructive testing (e.g., Ultrasonic Testing - UST) of axles in wheel shops?

options.A: UST Testing Certificate / Axle Inspection Register

questions.question: Which document is processed to report theft, shortage, or loss of workshop materials to Accounts and Security?

options.A: Survey Report / Loss & Damage Advice Report

questions.question: What is 'Survey Report' (Form S-2269) used for in workshop management?

options.A: Proposing write-off or condemnation of unserviceable machines, tools, or assets

questions.question: Which document records the transfer of finished overhauled components from the machine shop to the assembly line?

options.A: Component Voucher / Material Delivery Slip

questions.question: What document is processed to claim reimbursement for petty operational expenses incurred directly by a Shop SSE?

options.A: Imprest Cash Voucher / Petty Cash Vouchers

questions.question: What is 'Imprest Cash Account' held by a Workshop Senior Section Engineer?

options.A: Sanctioned standing cash fund for meeting urgent, minor local purchases and emergency repairs

questions.question: Which statutory document must be prominently displayed in the workshop under the Factories Act, 1948?

options.A: Notice of Periods of Work for Adults (Form 11 / Abstract of Factories Act & Safety Rules)

questions.question: Which register must be maintained in the workshop under statutory rules to record industrial accidents?

options.A: Register of Accidents and Dangerous Occurrences

questions.question: When an employee sustains an injury on duty, which document is immediately processed for medical treatment?

options.A: Medical Memo (Accident / On-Duty Injury Memo)

questions.question: Which document is processed by PCO when a design drawing modification is issued by RDSO / Metro Headquarters?

options.A: Modification Advice / Engineering Change Order (ECO)

questions.question: What document is used by Stores Stock Verifiers during physical counting of inventory in shop wards?

options.A: Stock Verification Sheet / Stock Sheets

questions.question: If a discrepancy (discrepant balance) is found between physical stock and register balance during audit, it is recorded on:

options.A: Stock Sheet (Accounts Stock Sheet)

questions.question: Which document is processed to certify that lifting tackles, cranes, and pressure vessels have undergone mandatory load testing?

options.A: Test Certificate by Competent Person (under Factories Act)

questions.question: How often must pressure vessels (e.g., air reservoirs) be tested and certified by a competent person in a workshop?

options.A: Periodically as per statutory rules (typically once every 12 months / 24 months)

questions.question: Which document records the daily logs of operating parameters (voltage, current, pressure, temperature) in a sub-station or AC plant?

options.A: Equipment Operating Log Book

questions.question: What is 'Shift Handover Register' maintained in continuous workshop sections?

options.A: Logbook where outgoing supervisor records pending jobs, machine status, and safety notes for incoming shift

questions.question: Which document is processed to purchase non-stock emergency items locally when unavailable in Stores Depot?

options.A: Local Purchase Requisition / Spot Purchase Sanction

questions.question: What is 'P.O.' in material processing documentation?

options.A: Purchase Order (Legal contract issued to vendor for supply of goods)

questions.question: What document does a vendor submit along with material delivery to the Workshop Stores Depot?

options.A: Vendor Invoice and Delivery Challan / Inspection Certificate

questions.question: Which register is processed to record safety gear (PPE like safety shoes, helmets, goggles) issued to workshop workers?

options.A: PPE Issue Register / Protective Clothing Register

questions.question: What is 'Standard Operation Procedure' (SOP) displayed near complex machines on the shop floor?

options.A: Document detailing safe operating steps, hazard warnings, and proper handling procedures for a machine
options.B: Document showing list of workers on leave

questions.question: Which document is processed to calculate and bill monthly incentive payments for Direct Workers?

options.A: Monthly Incentive Statement / Incentive Calculation Bill

questions.question: Who must audit and sign the Monthly Incentive Bills before payment is credited to workers' salaries?

options.A: Workshop Accounts Officer (WAO)

questions.question: What document is used to track precision instruments and gauges sent for periodic calibration?

options.A: Calibration Register / Instrument Master History Record

questions.question: What is 'Calibration Sticker / Tag' affixed on a measuring instrument in a workshop?

options.A: Tag showing date of last calibration, due date of next calibration, and inspector sign

questions.question: If an instrument's calibration due date has expired, what does quality documentation dictate?

options.A: Instrument must be tagged 'OUT OF SERVICE' and removed from shop floor until re-calibrated
options.C: Instrument must be thrown in scrap immediately

questions.question: Which document is processed to record detailed chemical/physical testing of raw materials in the Metallurgical & Chemical (M&C) Lab?

options.A: M&C Test Report / Material Test Certificate

questions.question: Which authority issues M&C Clearance for critical items like axle steel and welding consumables?

options.A: Chemist & Metallurgist / CMT Laboratory Wing

questions.question: What is 'Tool Issue Card / Tool Pass' held by a machinist?

options.A: Card/Token system used to draw specialized cutting tools from the Tool Room Ward

questions.question: Which document is processed when a tool is broken due to accident or mishandling on the shop floor?

options.A: Broken Tool Report / Breakage Memo

questions.question: What is 'Sub-Contracting / Job Work Document Folder'?

options.A: Processing folder containing work order details, tender agreement, gate passes, and inspection sheets for outsourced shop work

questions.question: Which document is processed for dispatching overhauled Metro rakes back to the Traffic/Operations Division?

options.A: Traffic Turn-Out Advice / Out-turn Certificate

questions.question: Who jointly signs the Rake Joint Inspection Certificate before a Metro train is accepted for revenue service?

options.A: Workshop SSE (Rolling Stock) and Traffic/Operations Representative

questions.question: What is 'Audit Objection Memo' processed in workshop accounts?

options.A: Formal query raised by Statutory Audit / Accounts regarding procedural or financial irregularity in workshop documents

questions.question: Which document is processed by PCO to schedule load management across different machine groups?

options.A: Capacity Load Sheet / Machine Load Chart

questions.question: What is 'Production Program' issued annually by Railway Board / Metro Headquarters?

options.A: Official document specifying targets for POH, IOH, and manufacturing for each workshop for the year

questions.question: Which document is processed when scrap materials are auctioned directly from the Workshop Store Yard?

options.A: Auction Sale Order / Delivery Order (Form S-2339)

questions.question: Which form is processed to record daily consumption of industrial gases (Oxygen, Acetylene, Argon) in welding shops?

options.A: Gas Consumption Register / Store Issue Log

questions.question: What is 'Material Safety Data Sheet' (MSDS) required for chemical items in workshops?

options.A: Document detailing chemical properties, health hazards, handling precautions, and first-aid measures for hazardous materials

questions.question: Which document is processed when a worker applies for casual leave or regular leave?

options.A: Leave Application Form

questions.question: Which record tracks the cumulative earned leave, half-pay leave, and commuted leave of a railway employee?

options.A: Leave Account (maintained in Service Book)

questions.question: What document is processed to issue railway travel passes/PTOs to workshop staff?

options.A: Pass / PTO Application Form

questions.question: Which register is processed to record all disciplinary cases, charge-sheets, and penalties of workshop staff?

options.A: D&AR Register (Discipline and Appeal Rules Register)

questions.question: What is 'Standard Form 5' (SF-5) processed for under D&AR rules?

options.A: Charge-sheet for Major Penalty

questions.question: What is 'Standard Form 11' (SF-11) processed for under D&AR rules?

options.A: Charge-sheet for Minor Penalty

questions.question: What is 'Standard Form 1' (SF-1) processed for?

options.A: Order of Suspension

questions.question: Which document is processed by Accounts to deduct union subscription fees from willing staff salaries (Voluntary Check-off system)?

options.A: Union Authorization Mandate / Check-off Form

questions.question: What is 'Service Book' maintained in the Personnel Branch?

options.A: Official cumulative record of an employee's career, promotions, pay fixations, leaves, and disciplinary history

questions.question: Under ISO 9001 quality management in workshops, what is a 'Corrective Action Report' (CAR)?

options.A: Document processed to investigate root cause of a quality defect and prevent its recurrence

questions.question: What is 'Internal Audit Non-Conformity Report' (NCR)?

options.A: Document detailing deviation from established ISO standard procedures discovered during workshop internal quality audit

questions.question: Which document is processed to record daily water quality parameters in Metro cooling towers and effluent treatment plants?

options.A: ETP / Water Testing Logbook (under ISO 14001 Environment Management)

questions.question: What is '5S Checklist' processed during shop floor audits?

options.A: Audit sheet for evaluating workplace organization, cleanliness, standardization, and discipline (Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain)

questions.question: Which document tracks the movement of vital safety-critical components (e.g., Metro rake couplers, bogies) through ultrasonic testing?

options.A: NDT Traceability Register / NDT Clearance Tag

questions.question: What is 'Traceability' in workshop quality documentation?

options.A: Ability to trace the history, application, raw material heat number, and operator details of a finished component using serial records

questions.question: Which document is processed by PCO when a Job Card is physically damaged or rendered illegible by oil/grease on shop floor?

options.A: Certified Duplicate Job Card (issued by PCO after canceling damaged card)

questions.question: In computerized processing (WISE/ERP), what is 'Digital Signature / Smart Authentication' used for?

options.A: Authenticating job completion, material requisitions, and gate passes securely without physical paper signatures

questions.question: Which document is processed to report scrap generation targets versus actual recovery to CWM monthly?

options.A: Monthly Scrap Target & Position Statement

questions.question: What is 'Works Register' maintained in Railway Workshop Accounts?

options.A: Register recording administrative approval, technical sanction, budget allocation, and progressive expenditure of capital works

questions.question: Which document is processed when an unserviceable machine tool is officially condemned by a Survey Committee?

options.A: Condemnation Certificate / Survey Report Approval

questions.question: What document is processed to account for scrap metal chips/borings generated during machining on a Work Order?

options.A: Scrap Return Advice (crediting scrap value back to WMS / Work Order)

questions.question: Which document is processed to record details of lubricants and oil changes in Metro rake gearboxes during maintenance?

options.A: Oil Change / Lubrication Log Card

questions.question: What is 'Defect Register' maintained at Metro depot stabling yards?

options.A: Register where Train Drivers (Loco Pilots) and maintenance staff record technical faults observed during service
options.C: Register of bad food in canteen

questions.question: Who must clear all entries in the Defect Register before a Metro rake is certified fit for commercial service?

options.A: Shift In-Charge / Senior Section Engineer (Depot/Workshop)

questions.question: Which document is processed when raw material received from a vendor fails dimensional checks during initial receiving inspection?

options.A: Rejection Note / Vendor Rejection Advice (Form S-717 / Equivalent)

questions.question: What is 'Warranty Rejection Advice' processed for?

options.A: Formal claim raised against a supplier when a component fails within its guaranteed warranty period on a coach/rake

questions.question: Which document is processed by PCO to issue monthly progress reports of coach overhaul to Railway Board?

options.A: Monthly Out-turn & Progress Report (MOPR)

questions.question: What is the standard period of retention for crucial workshop accounting ledgers like Work Order Ledgers?

options.A: Prescribed period under Railway Record Retention Rules (typically 5 to 10 years or as permanent record depending on capital nature)

questions.question: Why is systematic processing and filing of workshop documents essential?

options.A: Ensures complete quality traceability, legal compliance, accurate financial audit, and operational safety of Metro operations
options.C: To create unnecessary work for engineers

questions.question: In e-Office implementation across Metro Railway workshops, physical paper files are replaced by:

options.A: Electronic Files (e-Files) with digital movement and tracking
